atoms.exact_source_text: At Home, the crunch subject is the Colony. Citizens contribute in equal, individually apportioned shares; good stewardship creates a stable home that can run well, make room for ambition, and permit ordinary life to be experienced.
atoms.normalized_claim: Canonical premise: at Home the crunch subject is the Colony, with citizens contributing equal apportioned shares, and good stewardship creates a stable home enabling ambition and ordinary life.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Game-system target  | Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification 0.4.7                          |
atoms.normalized_claim: Game-system target field is Home Mode, Colony, and DWELL Specification 0.4.7.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Target architecture | MEDIAN Concept Sourcebook / System Architecture |
atoms.normalized_claim: Target architecture field is MEDIAN Concept Sourcebook / System Architecture.
Module field is Colony Register (DWELL) / Home Mode.

atoms.exact_source_text: RTS production grid     | Colony posture               | Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories. Places support Practices; Citizens occupy Roles; the colony succeeds as a whole.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model RTS production grid was reworked into Colony posture; consequence: buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories, Places support Practices, Citizens occupy Roles, and the colony succeeds as a whole.

atoms.exact_source_text: Worker optimization     | Equal civic shares           | Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home. Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Worker optimization was reworked into Equal civic shares; each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home, and personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode rather than domestic productivity ranking.

atoms.exact_source_text: Continuous entropy      | Achievable equilibrium       | Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load. The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Continuous entropy was reworked into Achievable equilibrium; adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load, allowing the colony to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.

atoms.exact_source_text: Local repair clicking   | Global condition             | Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Local repair clicking was reworked into Global condition; diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Passive debuffs         | Latent vulnerability         | Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure. They do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Passive debuffs was reworked into Latent vulnerability; Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure but do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.

atoms.exact_source_text: Generic random events   | Weakness-shaped MEET         | A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure. The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Generic random events was reworked into Weakness-shaped MEET; a hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure, and the two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.

atoms.exact_source_text: Five-button event board | Three-choice transaction     | A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Five-button event board was reworked into Three-choice transaction; a Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.

atoms.exact_source_text: Flavor text as reward   | Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY | Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space. EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.
atoms.normalized_claim: Prior model Flavor text as reward was reworked into Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY; competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space, and EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL). It replaces the familiar base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL), replacing the base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
